highlights: CJEU C-399/24 (16.10.2025): lightning strike on aircraft = extraordinary circumstance (Art. 5(3) VO 261/2004), comparable to bird strike — airline NOT liable for the delayed follow-on flight.
General Court T-656/24 (04.03.2026): airline cannot rely on an earlier-flight extraordinary circumstance if its own autonomous wait decision is the determining cause of the later delay.
2026 EU air passenger-rights reform: Council final clearance 13.07.2026 — 96h info duty, 30-day reply, no-show ban, hand baggage included by default, stronger PRM rights; expected in force ~Aug 2027.
Lufthansa warning strike 12.02.2026 confirms Krüsemann: internal staff strikes are NOT extraordinary circumstances; full EU261 compensation (up to €600) due.
